units.locator: Article 23.58. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Supervision in the Field of Geodesy and Cartography
units.text: 2. The following shall be entitled to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the authority specified in part 1 of this Article:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 23.58

units.locator: Article 23.58. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Supervision in the Field of Geodesy and Cartography
units.text: 1) the Chief State Inspector of the Russian Federation for Supervision in the Field of Geodesy and Cartography and his or her deputies;
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 23.58

units.locator: Article 23.58. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Supervision in the Field of Geodesy and Cartography
units.text: 2) chief state inspectors for supervision in the field of geodesy and cartography for constituent entities of the Russian Federation and their deputies.
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 23.58

units.locator: Article 23.59. Authorities Exercising State Control (Supervision) in the Sphere of Natural Monopolies
units.text: Article 23.59. Authorities Exercising State Control (Supervision) in the Sphere of Natural Monopolies
units.label: Art. 23.59

units.locator: Article 23.59. Authorities Exercising State Control (Supervision) in the Sphere of Natural Monopolies
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 23.59. Authorities Exercising State Control (Supervision) in the Sphere of Natural Monopolies
units.label: Art. 23.59

units.locator: Article 23.59. Authorities Exercising State Control (Supervision) in the Sphere of Natural Monopolies
units.text: 1. Authorities exercising state control (supervision) in the sphere of natural monopolies shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by part 3 of Article 19.5 and Article 19.8 (within their powers) of this Code.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 23.59

units.locator: Article 23.59. Authorities Exercising State Control (Supervision) in the Sphere of Natural Monopolies
units.text: 2. The following shall be entitled, within their powers, to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the authorities specified in part 1 of this Article:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 23.59

units.locator: Article 23.59. Authorities Exercising State Control (Supervision) in the Sphere of Natural Monopolies
units.text: 1) heads of federal executive authorities exercising federal state control (supervision) in the sphere of natural monopolies and their deputies;
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 23.59

units.locator: Article 23.59. Authorities Exercising State Control (Supervision) in the Sphere of Natural Monopolies
units.text: 2) heads of territorial authorities of federal executive authorities exercising federal state control (supervision) in the sphere of natural monopolies and their deputies;
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 23.59

units.locator: Article 23.59. Authorities Exercising State Control (Supervision) in the Sphere of Natural Monopolies
units.text: 3) heads of executive authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation exercising regional state control (supervision) in the sphere of natural monopolies and their deputies.
units.label: Point 3 Part 2 Art. 23.59

units.locator: Article 23.60. Federal Executive Authority Authorised in the Field of Currency Control
units.text: Article 23.60. Federal Executive Authority Authorised in the Field of Currency Control

units.label: Art. 23.60

units.locator: Article 23.60. Federal Executive Authority Authorised in the Field of Currency Control
units.text: 1. The federal executive authority authorised in the field of currency control shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by parts 1 - 2.1, 4 - 5 and 6 - 6.5 of Article 15.25 of this Code.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 23.60

units.locator: Article 23.60. Federal Executive Authority Authorised in the Field of Currency Control
units.text: 2. The following shall be entitled to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the authority specified in part 1 of this Article:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 23.60

units.locator: Article 23.60. Federal Executive Authority Authorised in the Field of Currency Control
units.text: 1) the head of the federal executive authority authorised in the field of currency control and his or her deputies;
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 23.60

units.locator: Article 23.60. Federal Executive Authority Authorised in the Field of Currency Control
units.text: 2) repealed. — Federal Law of 14.10.2014 No. 307-FZ;
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 23.60

units.locator: Article 23.60. Federal Executive Authority Authorised in the Field of Currency Control
units.text: 2.1) heads of structural divisions of the federal executive authority authorised in the field of currency control and their deputies;
units.label: Point 2.1 Part 2 Art. 23.60

units.locator: Article 23.60. Federal Executive Authority Authorised in the Field of Currency Control
units.text: 3) heads of territorial authorities of the federal executive authority authorised in the field of currency control and their deputies.
units.label: Point 3 Part 2 Art. 23.60

units.locator: Article 23.61. Federal Executive Authority Carrying Out State Registration of Legal Entities and Individual Entrepreneurs

units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 23.61. Federal Executive Authority Carrying Out State Registration of Legal Entities and Individual Entrepreneurs
units.label: Art. 23.61

units.locator: Article 23.61. Federal Executive Authority Carrying Out State Registration of Legal Entities and Individual Entrepreneurs
units.text: 1. The federal executive authority carrying out state registration of legal entities and individual entrepreneurs shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by parts 3 and 4 of Article 14.25 of this Code.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 23.61

units.locator: Article 23.61. Federal Executive Authority Carrying Out State Registration of Legal Entities and Individual Entrepreneurs
units.text: 2. The following shall be entitled to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the authority specified in part 1 of this Article:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 23.61

units.locator: Article 23.61. Federal Executive Authority Carrying Out State Registration of Legal Entities and Individual Entrepreneurs
units.text: 1) the head of the federal executive authority carrying out state registration of legal entities and individual entrepreneurs and his or her deputies;
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 23.61

units.locator: Article 23.61. Federal Executive Authority Carrying Out State Registration of Legal Entities and Individual Entrepreneurs
units.text: 2) heads of territorial authorities of the federal executive authority carrying out state registration of legal entities and individual entrepreneurs.
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 23.61

units.locator: Article 23.62. Authorities Exercising Control over Compliance with Legislation on Countering the Legalisation (Laundering) of Proceeds of Crime and the Financing of Terrorism
units.text: Article 23.62. Authorities Exercising Control over Compliance with Legislation on Countering the Legalisation (Laundering) of Proceeds of Crime and the Financing of Terrorism
units.label: Art. 23.62

units.locator: Article 23.62. Authorities Exercising Control over Compliance with Legislation on Countering the Legalisation (Laundering) of Proceeds of Crime and the Financing of Terrorism
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 23.62. Authorities Exercising Control over Compliance with Legislation on Countering the Legalisation (Laundering) of Proceeds of Crime and the Financing of Terrorism
units.label: Art. 23.62

units.locator: Article 23.62. Authorities Exercising Control over Compliance with Legislation on Countering the Legalisation (Laundering) of Proceeds of Crime and the Financing of Terrorism
units.text: 1. The federal executive authority authorised to take measures to counter the legalisation (laundering) of proceeds of crime, the financing of terrorism and extremist activity, and the financing of proliferation of weapons of mass destruction shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by Article 15.23.2, parts 1 - 3 of Article 15.27 (within its powers), and parts 2, 4, 6 and 7 of Article 15.39 of this Code.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 23.62

units.locator: Article 23.62. Authorities Exercising Control over Compliance with Legislation on Countering the Legalisation (Laundering) of Proceeds of Crime and the Financing of Terrorism
units.text: 2. The following shall be entitled to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the authority specified in part 1 of this Article:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 23.62

units.locator: Article 23.62. Authorities Exercising Control over Compliance with Legislation on Countering the Legalisation (Laundering) of Proceeds of Crime and the Financing of Terrorism
units.text: 1) the head of the federal executive authority authorised to take measures to counter the legalisation (laundering) of proceeds of crime, the financing of terrorism and extremist activity, and the financing of proliferation of weapons of mass destruction, and his or her deputies;
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 23.62

units.locator: Article 23.62. Authorities Exercising Control over Compliance with Legislation on Countering the Legalisation (Laundering) of Proceeds of Crime and the Financing of Terrorism
units.text: 2) heads of territorial authorities of the federal executive authority authorised to take measures to counter the legalisation (laundering) of proceeds of crime, the financing of terrorism and extremist activity, and the financing of proliferation of weapons of mass destruction, and their deputies.
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 23.62

units.locator: Article 23.64. Executive Authorities of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation Exercising Regional State Control (Supervision) in the Field of Shared-Participation Construction of Apartment Buildings and/or Other Real Estate
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 23.64. Executive Authorities of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation Exercising Regional State Control (Supervision) in the Field of Shared-Participation Construction of Apartment Buildings and/or Other Real Estate
units.label: Art. 23.64

units.locator: Article 23.64. Executive Authorities of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation Exercising Regional State Control (Supervision) in the Field of Shared-Participation Construction of Apartment Buildings and/or Other Real Estate
units.text: 1. Executive authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation exercising regional state control (supervision) in the field of shared-participation construction of apartment buildings and/or other real estate shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by part 1 of Article 13.19.2 (with respect to administrative offences committed by housing construction cooperatives constructing apartment buildings), Article 13.19.3 (with respect to administrative offences committed by a developer or a developer's officials), parts 1 - 5 of Article 14.28, Article 14.28.1 and part 4 of Article 19.5 of this Code.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 23.64

units.locator: Article 23.64. Executive Authorities of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation Exercising Regional State Control (Supervision) in the Field of Shared-Participation Construction of Apartment Buildings and/or Other Real Estate
units.text: 2. Heads and deputy heads of executive authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation authorised to exercise regional state control (supervision) in the field of shared-participation construction of apartment buildings and/or other real estate shall be entitled to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the authorities specified in part 1 of this Article.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 23.64

units.locator: Article 23.66. Procurement Control Authorities under the Legislation of the Russian Federation on the Contract System in Procurement
units.text: Article 23.66. Procurement Control Authorities under the Legislation of the Russian Federation on the Contract System in Procurement
units.label: Art. 23.66

units.locator: Article 23.66. Procurement Control Authorities under the Legislation of the Russian Federation on the Contract System in Procurement
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 23.66. Procurement Control Authorities under the Legislation of the Russian Federation on the Contract System in Procurement
units.label: Art. 23.66

units.locator: Article 23.66. Procurement Control Authorities under the Legislation of the Russian Federation on the Contract System in Procurement
units.text: 1. Procurement control authorities shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by parts 4 - 9 and 11 of Article 7.30.1, parts 1 - 4, 8 and 9 of Article 7.30.2, Articles 7.30.6 and 7.32.6 (within their powers, except the sphere of the state defence order), part 11 of Article 9.16 (except the spheres of the state defence order and state secrets), part 7 of Article 19.5, and Article 19.7.2 (except the spheres of the state defence order and state secrets) of this Code.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 23.66

units.locator: Article 23.66. Procurement Control Authorities under the Legislation of the Russian Federation on the Contract System in Procurement
units.text: 1.1. Cases concerning administrative offences provided for by parts 4 - 9 and 11 of Article 7.30.1, parts 1 - 4, 8 and 9 of Article 7.30.2, and Article 19.7.2 of this Code shall be heard by the federal executive authority authorised to exercise control in procurement where the case concerning such an administrative offence was initiated by an official of a local self-government authority authorised to exercise control in procurement.
units.label: Part 1.1 Art. 23.66

units.locator: Article 23.66. Procurement Control Authorities under the Legislation of the Russian Federation on the Contract System in Procurement
units.text: 1.2. Cases concerning administrative offences provided for by parts 4 - 9 and 11 of Article 7.30.1 and parts 1 - 4, 8 and 9 of Article 7.30.2 of this Code committed during procurement of goods, works or services for municipal needs shall be heard by the federal executive authority authorised to exercise control in procurement where the case concerning such an administrative offence was initiated by a prosecutor.
units.label: Part 1.2 Art. 23.66

units.locator: Article 23.66. Procurement Control Authorities under the Legislation of the Russian Federation on the Contract System in Procurement
units.text: 2. The following shall be entitled, within their powers, to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the authorities specified in part 1 of this Article:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 23.66

units.locator: Article 23.66. Procurement Control Authorities under the Legislation of the Russian Federation on the Contract System in Procurement
units.text: 1) heads of federal executive authorities in the sphere of procurement and their deputies;
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 23.66

units.locator: Article 23.66. Procurement Control Authorities under the Legislation of the Russian Federation on the Contract System in Procurement
units.text: 2) heads of structural divisions of federal executive authorities in the sphere of procurement and their deputies;
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 23.66

units.locator: Article 23.66. Procurement Control Authorities under the Legislation of the Russian Federation on the Contract System in Procurement
units.text: 3) heads of territorial authorities of federal executive authorities in the sphere of procurement and their deputies;
units.label: Point 3 Part 2 Art. 23.66

units.locator: Article 23.66. Procurement Control Authorities under the Legislation of the Russian Federation on the Contract System in Procurement
units.text: 4) heads of executive authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation in the sphere of procurement and their deputies;
units.label: Point 4 Part 2 Art. 23.66

units.locator: Article 23.66. Procurement Control Authorities under the Legislation of the Russian Federation on the Contract System in Procurement
units.text: 5) heads of structural divisions of executive authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation in the sphere of procurement and their deputies.
units.label: Point 5 Part 2 Art. 23.66

units.text: Article 23.68. Federal Executive Authority Authorised to Perform Functions of Compulsory Enforcement of Enforcement Documents and Ensuring the Established Procedure for Court Activities

units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 23.68. Federal Executive Authority Authorised to Perform Functions of Compulsory Enforcement of Enforcement Documents and Ensuring the Established Procedure for Court Activities
units.label: Art. 23.68

units.locator: Article 23.68. Federal Executive Authority Authorised to Perform Functions of Compulsory Enforcement of Enforcement Documents and Ensuring the Established Procedure for Court Activities
units.text: 1. The federal executive authority authorised to perform functions of compulsory enforcement of enforcement documents and ensuring the established procedure for court activities shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by Articles 13.26 and 17.8.1, parts 1 and 3 of Article 17.14, and parts 1, 1.3 and 2 of Article 17.15 of this Code.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 23.68

units.locator: Article 23.68. Federal Executive Authority Authorised to Perform Functions of Compulsory Enforcement of Enforcement Documents and Ensuring the Established Procedure for Court Activities
units.text: 2. The following shall be entitled to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the authority specified in part 1 of this Article:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 23.68

units.locator: Article 23.68. Federal Executive Authority Authorised to Perform Functions of Compulsory Enforcement of Enforcement Documents and Ensuring the Established Procedure for Court Activities
units.text: 1) the head of the federal executive authority authorised to perform functions of compulsory enforcement of enforcement documents and ensuring the established procedure for court activities and his or her deputies;
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 23.68

units.locator: Article 23.68. Federal Executive Authority Authorised to Perform Functions of Compulsory Enforcement of Enforcement Documents and Ensuring the Established Procedure for Court Activities
units.text: 2) heads of territorial authorities of that federal executive authority and their deputies;
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 23.68

units.locator: Article 23.68. Federal Executive Authority Authorised to Perform Functions of Compulsory Enforcement of Enforcement Documents and Ensuring the Established Procedure for Court Activities
units.text: 3) heads of units of that federal executive authority and its territorial authorities and their deputies.
units.label: Point 3 Part 2 Art. 23.68

units.locator: Article 23.69. units.locator: Article 23.69. Federal Executive Authority Authorised to Exercise State Control (Supervision) over the Activities of Self-Regulatory Organisations in Engineering Surveys, Architectural and Construction Design, Construction, Reconstruction and Major Repair of Capital Construction Facilities
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 23.69. Federal Executive Authority Authorised to Exercise State Control (Supervision) over the Activities of Self-Regulatory Organisations in Engineering Surveys, Architectural and Construction Design, Construction, Reconstruction and Major Repair of Capital Construction Facilities
units.label: Art. 23.69

units.locator: Article 23.69. Federal Executive Authority Authorised to Exercise State Control (Supervision) over the Activities of Self-Regulatory Organisations in Engineering Surveys, Architectural and Construction Design, Construction, Reconstruction and Major Repair of Capital Construction Facilities
units.text: 1. The federal executive authority authorised to exercise state control (supervision) over the activities of self-regulatory organisations in engineering surveys, architectural and construction design, construction, reconstruction and major repair of capital construction facilities shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by Article 9.5.1 of this Code, as well as by Article 14.52, part 1 of Article 14.63, Articles 14.64 and 14.64.1 and part 29.1 of Article 19.5 of this Code where those offences are committed by self-regulatory organisations in engineering surveys, architectural and construction design, construction, reconstruction and major repair of capital construction facilities.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 23.69
